verdict.rationale: This is an Agent Skills package that turns a host agent into a logo/identity designer. It runs inside whatever agent invokes it, and its workflow deliberately pauses at a human checkpoint. Setting up background automations that run on their own is a job for the agent platform, not for a design-skill package like this. Its in-session self-checks, such as rendering and auditing its own drafts, are not background automations, and nothing in the evidence shows it shipping such a feature.
